name: Jarvis Capture Router

nodes.name: Append to Vault (GitHub)
nodes.notes: GitHub 'edit file' replaces content; for true append, swap to a Get File -> Code (concat) -> Edit File trio, or use a Filesystem node if n8n runs on the same box as the synced vault.

_jarvis_import_notes: Import via n8n: Workflows -> ... -> Import from File. Then set env vars ANTHROPIC_KEY, HA_URL, HA_TOKEN (Settings -> Variables) and add GitHub credentials to the 'Append to Vault' node. The classifier system prompt mirrors resources/classification.md — keep them in sync. GitHub 'edit' overwrites; see the note on the Append node to switch to true-append before relying on it.
